title: FleetSieve: Decision-Critical Profiling for SLO-Aware LLM Fleet Configuration
abstract: arXiv:2608.19659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Choosing tensor-parallel (TP) degrees and replica counts for an LLM serving fleet is difficult because performance is not monotonic in TP and the feasible choice can change with load. Exhaustive profiling resolves this uncertainty, but measures many configurations that do not affect the final resource allocation. We present FleetSieve, which selects measurements according to their expected effect on a resource-coupled, SLO-aware fleet decision. FleetSieve models capacity and tail latency jointly, compares conservative and optimistic allocations, and stops when their remaining decision gap is below a specified tolerance. On a fixed H100 measurement grid for a 31B-parameter open-weight model, FleetSieve reaches the oracle aggregate decision using 22,200 GPU-seconds, 6.9% less than uniform random profiling in the fixed comparison. translated_title: FleetSieve：面向SLO感知的LLM舰队配置的决策关键剖析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19659v1 公告类型：新 摘要：为LLM服务舰队选择张量并行（TP）度和副本数量是困难的，因为性能在TP方面不是单调的，且可行选择可能随负载变化。穷举剖析解决了这一不确定性，但测量了许多不影响最终资源分配的配置。我们提出FleetSieve，它根据测量对资源耦合、SLO感知舰队决策的预期影响来选择测量项。FleetSieve联合建模容量和尾部延迟，比较保守与乐观分配，并在其剩余决策差距低于指定容差时停止。在固定H100测量网格上，针对一个31B参数开放权重模型，FleetSieve使用22,200 GPU秒达到预言机聚合决策，比固定比较中的均匀随机剖析少6.9%。在200个随机揭示顺序中，其平均节省比随机剖析高5.4%（95%自举置信区间：3.5-7.2%）。
tldr: FleetSieve通过智能选择关键测量配置，在满足SLO约束下，显著减少了LLM舰队配置的剖析开销，实现了高效的资源分配决策。
en_tdlr: FleetSieve intelligently selects critical profiling measurements to reduce profiling overhead while meeting SLO constraints, enabling efficient resource allocation decisions for LLM fleets.
